Detection precision, recall, F1 and one-to-one match counts

Source: R/detection-validation.R
aqt_detection_metrics.Rd

Precision is undefined (NA) when no predictions exist, except that unobserved classes are omitted. Recall is undefined without references. F1 is 0 when one of the defined precision/recall values is zero; otherwise undefined if either input is undefined.

Usage

aqt_detection_metrics(
  truth,
  pred,
  iou_threshold = 0.5,
  confidence_threshold = 0.25,
  evaluated_frames = NULL
)

Arguments

truth, pred

Reference and predicted boxes.

iou_threshold

Match threshold.

confidence_threshold

Prediction confidence cutoff.

evaluated_frames

Optional fully annotated frame manifest.

Value

Per-class rows plus a micro-pooled ALL row.
